sourceFitAssessment.reasoning: The 10 by 10 grid has 100 cohort glyphs and 20 filled event glyphs, a five-year defined event and complete follow-up. Sorted positions are explicitly for counting rather than identity; a separate unknown person blocks inference to a named fate. The next panel keeps a model estimate dependent on inputs, setting and calibration. The current owner example supplies its distinct 10% assigned-risk group, and the linked unchanged calibration pair supplies predicted-versus-observed groups at the same horizon. Together they distinguish observed frequency, model probability and individual outcome identity. Alt, caption and practice do not make a personal forecast.
